entries.author: teacher
entries.content: Fixed. The root cause: `describe_training_job` (and sibling not-found paths in `delete_training_job`, `describe_processing_job`, and the experiment/trial/trial-component paths) called `FakeTrainingJob.arn_formatter` / `FakeProcessingJob.arn_formatter` / `FakeTrial.arn_formatter`, which didn't exist, raising `AttributeError` instead of the expected `ValidationError`. I added the missing `arn_formatter` staticmethods to `FakeTrainingJob`, `FakeProcessingJob`, and `FakeTrial` (following the existing `FakeEndpoint` pattern), and updated all call sites to pass `account_id` along with the region. All 96 sagemaker tests pass, and non-existent resource lookups now raise a ClientError with code `ValidationException` and a proper ARN message.
